import pandas as pd


def clean_column(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    corrections = {
        'E5': 'Almere',
    }
    lhs_text = df['codex'].astype(str).where(df['codex'].notna())
    fix = lhs_text.isin(list(corrections)) & df['cityx'].notna()
    df.loc[fix, 'cityx'] = lhs_text[fix].map(corrections)
    known = df.dropna(subset=['codex', 'cityx']).groupby('codex')['cityx'].unique()
    single = {key: values[0] for key, values in known.items() if len(values) == 1}
    fill = df['cityx'].isna() & df['codex'].isin(list(single))
    df.loc[fill, 'cityx'] = df.loc[fill, 'codex'].map(single)
    return df
